tmds_pll.description: A TMDS serializer's clock manager: the display's pixel clock in, five times it out, reprogrammable at run time over its registers -- each load resets and relocks it, so it has no reset of its own -- a recipe per display clock, the feedback multiplier always five times the output divider, so the x5 relation holds at every clock. Its outputs are unbuffered: the bit clock it makes is regional (tmds_clocking).

in_khz.description: The pixel clock it is configured for at reset: the default display clock's.

inputs.name: ctrl
inputs.description: The recipe registers: divider and multiplier at 0x200, the x5 output's divider at 0x208, load at 0x25C, lock at 0x004.

outputs.name: clkfb_out
outputs.description: The feedback, to return through a deskew buffer.

clk_wiz.description: AMD's clocking wizard as an MMCM with dynamic reconfiguration over AXI4-Lite, which keeps the lock and filter tables for each recipe it is given. An MMCM, not a PLL: only an MMCM's outputs reach a BUFIO, over the region's high-performance clock lines.
